prompt:
CONCEPT: a citizen of the Oxygen Nation, of the Water House. A female personification character with the sea itself — carried as a sailor's cloak of waves, shells, a tide-line hem as her motif — the object reimagined as a woman in cloth and ornament that carry its materials, colors, shape and motifs. She does NOT hold, carry or wield the object; it is not a separate object. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Oxygen (O) to carry in her design and the scene: breath and fire and rust in one: cool clear air as translucent cloth, bright combustion orange as accents, the quiet power to corrode, the deep blue of oceans and the green of forests; it is the element of life and burning. Palette: sea blue, forest green, clear white, combustion orange.
HOUSE TRAITS of Water: water as it lives on the ground: sea, river, well and drinking water — deep blues and greens, flowing fabric, reflected light; the holding, life-giving side of water. Palette: deep sea blue, river green, white foam, sand.
AGE: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
SILHOUETTE: voluptuous, generously curved at bust, hips and thighs build; long side-swept hair with choppy uneven bangs; ocean-blue hair.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a glamorous, sultry allure; bronze-brown skin; oval face; large eyes — deep-set eyes, outer eye corners tilting sharply upward; thin arched brows; upturned nose; full wide lips; leaf-green eyes; glossy nude lips.
WORLD — MECHA: year 2200, an ocean terraforming station: oxygen-generation towers venting white plumes, coral-glass domes, blue-green plasma light. MECHA DESIGN: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. white and sea-blue armor with clear visor panels, bubble-shaped pauldrons, tank-and-valve motifs, combustion-orange glow lines, a back unit of two rounded tanks. Her object leads the mecha design — its silhouette and parts must read at first glance in the plates, binders, helmet and back unit.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, anime facial design that keeps each character's own facial structure, eye proportions and skin tone instead of one house face, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
EXPRESSION: level brow, direct unhurried gaze, chin slightly raised, mouth closed and composed.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (O) and atomic number (8) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
